description.text: Battle Academy, launched on 31 July 2020 to teach new players and families the game: three 60-card decks led by Charizard-GX, Raichu-GX and Mewtwo-GX, with a folding two-player game board, three deck boxes, a rulebook, two tutorial guides, a large metallic coin, damage counters and a code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online. It was based on the Japanese Family Pokémon Card Game of 15 March 2019. Its cards are Sun & Moon reprints marked with a silhouette of their deck's lead Pokémon. In the Charizard and Raichu decks, which have the two tutorials, the mark also carries a number, the card's place in the order the tutorial has players stack the deck in.
